description: This file defines a SizeCalculator class used for analyzing ELF binaries and build logs to calculate memory section sizes, including sections for RAM and ROM, and generating reports. It is part of a larger testing or build analysis framework.

classes.name: SizeCalculator
classes.description: A class for analyzing ELF binaries and build logs to determine memory section sizes, including sections for RAM and ROM, and generating size reports.

methods.name: size_report
methods.description: Prints a report of section sizes and totals.

methods.name: get_used_ram
methods.description: Returns the amount of RAM used by the application.

methods.name: get_used_rom
methods.description: Returns the amount of ROM used by the application.

methods.name: unrecognized_sections
methods.description: Returns a list of sections in the binary that were not recognized.

methods.name: get_available_ram
methods.description: Returns total available RAM.

methods.name: get_available_rom
methods.description: Returns total available ROM.

methods.name: _calculate_sizes
methods.description: Analyzes ELF file and optionally reads build.log to calculate sizes.

methods.name: _check_elf_file
methods.description: Verifies the file is an ELF binary.

methods.name: _check_is_xip
methods.description: Checks if the ELF binary is configured for XIP (execute-in-place).

methods.name: _get_info_elf_sections
methods.description: Extracts section information from ELF file and updates size totals.

methods.name: _analyze_elf_file
methods.description: Performs ELF analysis including checks and section info extraction.

methods.name: _get_buildlog_file_content
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of the build.log file.

methods.name: _find_offset_of_last_pattern_occurrence
methods.description: Finds the position in build.log where memory footprint info starts.

methods.name: _get_lines_with_footprint
methods.description: Extracts lines related to memory footprint from build.log.

methods.name: _clear_whitespaces_from_lines
methods.description: Removes whitespace and trailing '%' from lines.

methods.name: _divide_text_lines_into_columns
methods.description: Splits lines into columns based on whitespace.

methods.name: _unify_prefixes_on_all_values
methods.description: Converts size values to a common unit (bytes).

methods.name: _binary_prefix_converter
methods.description: Converts size strings with units (KB, MB, GB) to bytes.

methods.name: _create_data_table
methods.description: Creates a data table from build.log content with memory info.

methods.name: _get_footprint_from_buildlog
methods.description: Extracts memory footprint data from build.log and updates size totals.
